captions.instagram:
Most notes apps keep your writing inside their service. rotli starts from the other end: every note is a plain Markdown file in one folder you choose.

Open it in any editor. Back it up however you already back things up. Delete rotli and every word is still there.

Free, no account, works offline: rotli.co

captions.linkedin:
A notes app should never be the only way to reach your notes.

rotli keeps every note as a plain Markdown file in one folder you choose, and its own settings and indexes are rebuildable. That means:
• Your notes open in any Markdown editor.
• You back them up the way you already back things up.
• If you ever delete rotli, the folder is still full of readable notes.

Free, no account, and it works offline. rotli.co
